Iovance Biotherapeutics Raises Full Year 2026 Revenue Guidance to $410 to $420 Million

New Guidance Represents an Increase of $55 Million at the Midpoint from the Prior Range of $350 to $370 Million

PHILADELPHIA, Pennsylvania, September 29, 2026 -- Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: IOVA), a commercial biotechnology company focused on innovating, developing, and delivering novel polyclonal tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapies for patients with cancer, today raised its full year 2026 total revenue guidance range to $410 to $420 million, driven by strong U.S. demand for Amtagvi® (lifileucel) and Proleukin. The midpoint represents an increase of $55 million, or ~15%, over the previous guidance range of $350 to $370 million and implies nearly 60% annual growth in total revenue.
